final: WITH g AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS pt_avg, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS diff_avg FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(diff_avg) AS overall FROM g WHERE diff_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.SEX, AVG(g.pt_avg) AS avg_group_pt, AVG(g.diff_avg) AS avg_group_diff, AVG(g.diff_avg / o.overall) AS avg_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.SEX ORDER BY g.SEX
